description: This file defines the Sponsor class, which models sponsor entities within the Goteo project. It includes constants, properties, and methods for retrieving, validating, saving, and reordering sponsors, as well as handling sponsor types and images.

classes.name: Sponsor
classes.description: Represents sponsors with properties like id, node, name, url, image, type, and order. Provides methods for CRUD operations, reordering, validation, and retrieving sponsor types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a sponsor by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all sponsors for a specific node, or the current node if not specified.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sponsors with optional filtering by type, pagination, and count.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates sponsor data for required fields: name and url.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves sponsor data, including handling image uploads.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves a sponsor up in the order within its node.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves a sponsor down in the order within its node.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Gets the next order value for adding a new sponsor.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of sponsor types.
